title: Recognise and play A-List releases
description: Identify orange A-List distribution and use the matching dark player with orange media controls.

steps.caption: 1. A-List release cards use orange borders and audience badges, distinct from normal Dub releases.
2. Expand the release to browse its ordered tracks.
3. Open pack uses the dark A-List player with orange playback and waveform controls.
4. Public A-List releases can be shared externally. Restricted releases require approved access.
5. Artist approval and release audience are separate: an approved artist can publish worldwide too.
